title: Fun for the Whole Family at Coventry Libraries' FREE Big Book Bash!
summary: Get ready for a day packed with stories, creativity and fun! Coventry Libraries is bringing its FREE Big Book Bash to Coventry Transport Museum on Wednesday 28 October, from 10am to 3.30pm

title: Learn how to do business with Coventry City Council
summary: Local businesses can find out more about working with Coventry City Council through a new series of free webinars.

title: Council uses new Renters’ Rights Act powers to protect private tenants
summary: The Council has used new enforcement powers available, following the introduction of the Renters’ Rights Act 2025, to take action against landlords for breaches of tenancy law.

title: Reaching out to unpaid carers
summary: Coventry City Council is supporting a major national pilot survey to gather the experiences of unpaid carers.

title: Coventry Good Citizen Award honours community champions
summary: Two Coventry residents have been recognised with Good Citizen Awards for their dedication to supporting vulnerable people.

title: CVLR takes second major award
summary: Coventry Very Light Rail has won a second major award this month.
